name: Ouhime-sama ni Manabu! Shota Orc-kun no Tanezuke Kyouiku Nisshi
original_name: 王姫様に学ぶ!ショタオーク君の種付け教育日誌
source:
Nestled in the forest the "shota orc"
was attacked by wicked monster

It seemed his life was over when,
before him appeared a queen-princess and her soldiers.

The shota orc asked to be saved, but the princess had a price,
which was that would join her side and administer punishments
to the criminals of her kingdom.

The orcs were few. The shota orc was a weak-willed virgin.

He accepted his charge and began his new life.
The queen-princess would raise him into a splendid orc
and sic him on brigands and murderesses! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE189589.html]DLsite English[/url]]
